name: io.github.andreasjhagen/sftp-ssh
description: MCP server for SFTP file operations and SSH command execution

environmentVariables.name: SFTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Remote SSH/SFTP host name or IP address.

environmentVariables.name: SFTP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password authentication. Omit when using a private key.

environmentVariables.name: SFTP_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Local path to an SSH private key. Omit when using a password or inline key.

environmentVariables.name: SFTP_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Inline SSH private key. Literal \n sequences are converted to newlines.

environmentVariables.name: SFTP_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Remote path exposed as the MCP root (default: /).

environmentVariables.name: SSH_HOST_FINGERPRINT
environmentVariables.description: Optional SHA-256 host-key fingerprint in OpenSSH SHA256:base64 or hexadecimal format.
